reviews.title: Love the design, comfort and ease
reviews.comment: Assembly was a breeze with the Amazon Basics Ergonomic Executive Office Desk Chair. The instructions were clear and easy to follow, and I had the chair put together quickly without any hassle. This simple setup made the whole experience even more satisfying from the start. In terms of comfort, the chair truly delivers. It provides excellent lumbar support, I assume it will make long hours at my desk much more enjoyable. The adjustable height feature lets me customize my seating position, and the flip-up armrests allow me to slide the chair neatly under my desk without worrying about damage. Overall, I couldn’t be happier with my purchase. The chair looks stunning in my office and perfectly complements the decor. It combines style, comfort, and practicality at a fantastic value, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to upgrade their office chair. I love you so much that I ordered another one for my husband’s desk.
reviews.author: Jenny

reviews.title: Comfortable, Supportive & Great Value!
reviews.comment: This chair is super comfortable and gives great back support, especially for long sitting hours. Easy to assemble, looks sleek, and the flip-up arms are a nice bonus—definitely worth it!
reviews.author: Rhonda Grow-Davis

reviews.title: Perfect chair!
reviews.comment: I love this chair! Was hesitant to buy due to the price being a bit more than I wanted to spend, but I work from home and have terrible posture from sitting at my desk all day, so I needed something that would be conducive to helping me sit up properly. I put the chair together myself, it was heavy but overall pretty easy to do. The tools provided worked great and the directions were clear. Aesthetically, it’s a lovely neutral color and everyone who has seen it so far has complimented me and on how nice it is and how comfortable it looks — Indeed it’s a very expensive looking chair. The first time I sat on it I wasn’t sure if I was going to like it….maybe something about the lumbar support seeming to protrude too much? At any rate, I gave it a couple of days and I absolutely LOVE it. I can already feel my posture improving, no backaches and I’m perfectly comfortable all day long. I’ve had it for a couple weeks now and couldn’t be happier. It seems to be very well made, so I’m confident it will last a very long time and be worth the price. I HIGHLY recommend this chair!
reviews.author: KD

reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.comment: It was easy to put together. Material feels durable. Only downside is that it doesn't tilt lock and the arm rest height isn't adjustable (though it can be folded up). I'm 4'11" and the back is the perfect height for me with great neck and lumbar support. My feet kinda dangle but I use a foot rest so it's not a big deal. My boyfriend who's 5'10" says it's comfy but the back could be taller.
reviews.author: Mika

reviews.title: Amazing to Sit in All Day
reviews.comment: I had the older model of this chair for four years. The chair become squeaky, the seat was deflating, one of the arms was loose, and my cat scratched it to pieces but let me be clear - I could not live without that chair. I was so sad to search my order history and find out that Amazon no longer made that chair but was very excited when I discovered they actually changed their name and had an improved model. Let me also say that this cream color is a gorgeous color in person and it goes well in my living room and matches my desk aesthics. The cream color allows it to blend in with everything around it while giving it a classy look. I can't say if it's easy to assemble because my husband assembled it not me, but he didn't complain or get frustrated so must not be too bad. The chair is very comfortable to sit in all day. I work from home and then use my computer in the evenings as well so I'm in this chair sometimes 12 hours a day. My computer set up is in the living room so my chair is accessible to guests and they run to sit in my chair when they come in the house instead of sitting on the sofa. I did have a bit of a break in period but that could just be because I was so used to my old chair that I needed to adjust to it. I'm a plus size gal - coming in at a size 18 - and it's so wide that I have no trouble fitting into this chair. There is plenty of room on the sides of me. The arms move up and down which one of my favorite features. My only complaint is that I wish the chair would go higher than it does. I'm 5'7" and sometimes I want to sit higher but I'm maxed out. Seems odd so maybe the problem is user error.
reviews.author: Valdeezie
